title: P0.1 Route 2 Energy Reranker vs SC on Selectable-Headroom Corpus v1
methodology_note: step_aggregation_energy_accuracy is None because per_step_traces_captured=False in the fallback corpus. self_certainty_BoN collapses to SC because all mean_token_logprob values are None in this corpus.

field_provenance.honest_verdict: complete:/success:/passed:/shipped_ prefix per Verdict Terminal-Prefix Discipline; lets the conductor reconciler classify terminal vs partial.
field_provenance.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates — no live model; sub-1s floor is legitimate (scoring cached generations with numpy/sklearn only).
field_provenance.corpus_oracle_exceeds_sc: The FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISK precondition: oracle > SC means the correct answer IS present as a selectable minority, so a non-degenerate reranker CAN win.
field_provenance.selectable_headroom: oracle - SC on the scored corpus; measures how much room a reranker has to improve over majority vote.
field_provenance.reranker_makes_distinct_selections: Non-degeneracy de-flag: if True, the reranker selects at least one answer different from SC, so the result is not a tautological null (exp3507 fix).
field_provenance.headroom_corpus_n: Held-out problems scored (>= 40 required); below 40 the estimate is too noisy to support a distributional claim.
field_provenance.self_consistency_accuracy: Majority-vote accuracy — the PRIMARY CONTROL, reported once. All deltas are computed against this value.
field_provenance.step_aggregation_energy_accuracy: exp3520's confirmed min-aggregation scorer; None here because this corpus has no per-step FoVer traces (per_step_traces_captured=False).
field_provenance.pessimistic_bon_energy_accuracy: Pessimistic-BoN energy (penalize over-confident flips) per arXiv:2604.04648; directly targets exp3519's wrong-flip failure mode.
field_provenance.optimal_aggregation_accuracy: Best energy condition held-out accuracy — THE headline condition (DISTINCT from SC when reranker_makes_distinct_selections=True).
field_provenance.best_condition: The energy condition with the highest held-out accuracy; used to identify which mechanism (if any) drives the improvement.
field_provenance.flip_count_best_vs_sc: Problems where the best condition differs from SC — the tautology-clean primary signal; MUST be > 0 for a non-degenerate result.
field_provenance.flips_correct_best: Flips that became CORRECT (win mechanism: recovering minority-correct answers that SC dismissed).
field_provenance.flips_incorrect_best: Flips that became WRONG (cost: incorrectly overriding SC's correct majority).
field_provenance.net_correctness_gain_best: flips_correct - flips_incorrect; the honest net effect of reranking. Positive = energy reranker adds value on this corpus.
field_provenance.delta_best_vs_self_consistency: Best condition minus SC at matched compute — THE headline delta. Positive AND significant (p<0.05) = G1 gate passes.
field_provenance.paired_significance: McNemar exact p + paired bootstrap CI95 for the best-condition delta; establishes statistical confidence rather than relying on point estimates.
field_provenance.random_seed: Determinism; CONTENT-DERIVED (sha256 of corpus + config string), NOT the experiment number — per CLAUDE.md Adversarial Artifact Verification.
field_provenance.reproducibility_checksum: Content hash of corpus + reranker config + seed; lets a third party confirm the exact data the artifact was computed over.
field_provenance.duration_s: Wall-clock time; cached scoring + sklearn only, so 1s floor is legitimate and DURATION_TOO_SHORT adversarial flag should not fire.
